html:
Greetings, Agents! 
 
This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

The Symbiote Invasion has begun in MARVEL Future Fight this September.

 

Meet the Symbiotes that have become even stronger 
and Gorr, who, in another time, wielded the first Symbiote Sword.
Check out the <Symbiote Invasion II> inspired Update.

 

Two new heroes, native Tier-3 Gorr the God Butcher and Toxin 
who can be upgraded to Potential Transcendence, will be added!

 

The existing Symbiotes will be upgraded as well!
Tier-4 for Venom and Potential Transcendence for Scream and Agent Venom will be added!
In addition, 5 new Artifacts and 3 new Uniforms have been prepared 
to support the growth of the updated heroes.

 

Also, an important point of the Update!
The Alliance Battle Legend difficulty and the Set Dealer feature have been added.
Please check out the details below.

 

▣ Two New Heroes

 

Gorr the God Butcher and Toxin, who has exceptional physical abilities, have been added. 
* The hero skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

▣ Three New Uniforms

 

New Uniforms for the hosts of the Symbiotes have been added. 
* New Uniform Skills are based on the following Skill Level stats. (Tier-4 heroes: Lv. 10, Others: Lv. 6)    
* The three new uniforms will be on a 40% off discount during the <New Update Celebration Event!>,  
and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room after the event.

 

 

 

 

▣ Gorr Tier-3 Ultimate Skill 

 

Check out the powerful abilities of the shadow 
with the Tier-3 Ultimate Skill of Gorr.

 

 

 

▣ Scream, Agent Venom, and Toxin Potential Awakening & Transcendence

 

Through the September Update, Scream, Agent Venom, and Toxin 
will be available for Potential Awakening & Transcendence!

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Venom Tier-4 Advancement & Striker Skill

 

Venom will advance to Tier-4 and gain a new Striker Skill.
Check out the powerful abilities of Venom.
* The Striker Skill stats are based on skill level 6.

 

 

▣ Squad Battle End & Alliance Battle Legend Mode Release

 

The Squad Battle will end and the Alliance Battle: Legend mode has been added!
Challenge Surtur who has become even stronger through battles.

 

1. Squad Battle will end after the September Update.
Related changes and rewards are as follows.

 

[Changes with Squad Battle challenges and rewards]
- Squad Battle participation challenges will be changed to Alliance Battle participation challenges. 
- Awakening Crystals and Mandalay Gem Fragment
that could be acquired from Squad Battle can now be acquired from Alliance Battle.

 

[Squad Battle Season Reward Distribution]
1. The league and rank rewards for the following season will be distributed through the Inbox.
① Agents who have participated in Squad Battle at least once during the following period. 
9/18 (Sun) 15:00 - Until the September Update (UTC+0), 
9/18 (Sun) 8:00 - Until the September Update (PDT)
② Agents who have not received the season rewards for the following season 
before the September Update Maintenance. 
9/11 (Sun) 15:00 - 9/18 (Sun) 14:59 (UTC+0), 
9/11 (Sun) 8:00 - 9/18 (Sun) 7:59 (PDT) 

 

2. Alliance Battle Legend Mode has been released.
- The Legend Mode will be unlocked 

when reaching a certain score in Extreme Mode or Extreme Challenge Mode.
* Unlock Requirement: Achieve 1,000,000 points in Extreme

 

 

Achieve higher scores in the Legend Mode by challenging the following battle features.

 

[Odin’s Might]: A shining purple circle will appear on the map 
when a text showing that Odin’s Might has been used is displayed. 

A bonus to increase points by % will be applied when your hero acquires the circle.

 

 


[Odinforce]: A bonus to increase points by % increases greatly
when four Odin’s Mights are acquired and the gauge reaches 100%.
- The gauge decreases as time passes, so make your attack when the bonus is applied!

 

 

[Recommended Skill Notice]: 
An icon will be displayed on skills with recommended effects during the battle.

 

 

3. 60,000 Gold is needed to proceed with Legend Challenge Mode.

 

4. 200 Crystals are needed to continue Legend Mode when all heroes have been defeated. 

 

5. The Legend Mode scores will also be counted for the Alliance Battle Weekly Ranking Reward, 

MVP Rewards, and Alliance Tournament final 16 entrance. 

 

6. A relay challenge for participating in Alliance Battle: Legend Mode has been added.

 

7. Please check below for the Alliance Battle rewards.

 

[Alliance Battle: Weekly Ranking Reward]

 

[Alliance Battle: Score Reward]
- Normal Mode: Lv.5 Exp Chip, Mandalay Gem Fragment, and Awakening Crystal 

have been added as rewards, and the amount of some rewards have been increased.
- Extreme Mode: Awakening Crystal and Mandalay Gem Fragment have been added as rewards.
- Please check the chart below for the rewards for each mode.
 

 

 

 

[9/20 (Tue) 11:29 (UTC+0), 9/20 (Tue) 4:29 (PDT) added]
The 100,000 score ISO-8 reward for Legend Mode has been fixed to be more precise.
A 6★ rank or a 6★ 1 Awakened (★ red star) - 6 Awakened ISO-8 can be randomly acquired from the chest.

 

[9/21 (Wed) 9:17 (UTC+0), 9/21 (Wed) 2:17 (PDT) added]
The 500,000 score Comic Card Chest reward for Legend Mode has been fixed.
A 4★ - 6★ Comic Card can be randomly acquired from the Comic Card Chest.

 

[10/5 (Wed) 6:00 (UTC+0), 10/4 (Tue) 23:00 (PDT) added]
The name of the Legend Mode rewards have been changed to be more accurate.
Please note that the rewards have not been changed.

 

▣ Set Dealer Feature

 

A feature to set a dealer to appear first when entering a stage instead of the leader has been added.

 

1. Agents can set a dealer from [My Team] -> [Set Dealer] 

or at the team selection screen before entering a game mode.
- The slot for the dealer can be set for each team.
- Agents can select a specific slot as the dealer slot, not the character, 
and the character in the slot will be selected as a dealer.

 

 

[Target Contents]
Story, Story: Ultimate Mode, Dimension Mission, Dispatch Mission, 
Timeline Battle, Epic Quest, Dimension Rift, Event Mission 

 

2. The following will be applied when Auto Progressing 
Story: Ultimate with the Auto Use Designated Characters feature.
- Designated heroes will fill empty slots first. 

If there are no empty slots, slots that are not dealer slots will be filled first.
- If the designated hero is already in a slot, the slot will not be changed.
- When all three designated heroes are set, the hero in the dealer slot will participate in the battle first.

 

▣ New Artifacts

 

Exclusive passive skill Artifacts will be added for 
Gorr, Toxin, Venom, Agent Venom, and Scream after the September Update.
* The Artifact Skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass will start after the update.
Obtain various rewards along with Special Icons with the Future Pass!


[Future Pass Rewards]

- Please note that the Future Pass effects 
will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Opened Legendary / Mythic Future Pass will only be applied during the season 
the Pass was purchased, and the Pass rewards will only be available during the same season. 
Please don’t forget to check the remaining event time!
- The Mythic Pass can only be purchased after purchasing the Legendary Pass.
- Legendary and Mythic Future Pass will not be available for purchase 
when the season is about to end. Please check the sale period in the game.
 

​New Special Icons have been added for our Agents!
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Rewards and one more from the upcoming Event!


[September Update New Special Icon]
   


▣ New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms from the September Update!
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward!

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. A feature to turn Skill VFX and Skill Cooldown Display On/Off in Preview Skill has been added.
- The Skill VFX can be turned On/Off from [Combat Settings] -> [Turn on Skill VFX].
- The Skill Cooldown Display that shows the skill cooldown time of all skills 
including Ultimate / Awakened / and Striker skills can be turned On/Off from 
[Combat Settings] -> [Turn on Skill Cooldown Display].

 

 

2. The skill information that is displayed in the Marvel Universe has been improved 
to show the maximum skill level information according to the status and the level of the hero.

 

3. The Dimension Rift banner and a notice mark will now be displayed at the bottom right corner 
of the main lobby screen when a Dimension Rift contribution reward can be received.
     
4. Agents will now be moved to the main screen and automatically re-matched 
when being disconnected from Multiverse Invasion.

 

5. Ultimate Skills can now be canceled when Giant Boss Raid Dormammu 
or World Boss Gorr starts a specific pattern.

 

6. The hero skill information tooltip has been improved 

and the description for some skill effects has been fixed.
- The tooltip that is displayed when selecting the skill icon at 
[Team] / [Marvel Universe] / [Uniform Room] has been improved.

 


7. The Tier-3 skill effects of Venom has been improved to be continued

when using another skill during the skill usage.

 

8. C.T.P.s will no longer be consumed as a material 

when enhancing or changing the option of Custom Gear.

 

9. The notice pop-up screen that appears when using C.T.P.s as a material 
when reforging or changing the option of C.T.P. has been improved.

 

▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The issue of the skill cooldown time of tagged heroes 
not being decreased in Giant Boss Raid has been fixed. 

 

2. The issue of the C.T.P. option auto change not being stopped 
even if the selected option has appeared when proceeding auto option change 
after reforging a normal C.T.P. to a Mighty C.T.P. has been fixed.  
- The issue does not occur when proceeding with a normal option change first after reforging.
- The issue only occurs when proceeding with auto option change for the first time.
The issue does not occur when proceeding with auto option change for the same C.T.P. additionally.
- Materials consumed will be distributed to Agents who have 
continued auto option change after the selected option has appeared due to the issue.

 

[9/21 (Wed) 9:17 (UTC+0), 9/21 (Wed) 2:17 (PDT) added]
Related rewards have been distributed during the maintenance through the Inbox.

 

3. The occasional issue of the acquired score text 
not being displayed properly in certain game modes has been fixed.

 

4. The issue of the Alliance Battle season information not being updated
when remaining on the main screen at the point of the weekly reset has been fixed. 

 

5. The Biometrics auto-select feature can be used normally when increasing the level of heroes.

 

6. The issue of skipping the pattern of World Boss Legend: Infinity Ultron 
through certain methods has been fixed.

 

7. The counterattack skill VFX activation timing 
when using the 3rd skill of Hulkbuster (Iron Man Mark 44) <3099> has been adjusted.

 

8. The issue of the sound not being played in iOS devices
when the Dimension Rift push notice has been received has been fixed.

 

9. The issue of the last hero standing in Alliance Conquest with the revive effect 

not reviving to continue the battle and being defeated due to the time limit has been fixed.

 

10. The issue of Gold not being consumed 

when using the auto-dismantle feature for Artifact Chest has been fixed.
- A feature to show the amount of Gold possessed and the dismantle cost 
when using the auto-dismantle feature has been added. 
 

We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.
​
Thank you.
